text:
Ava: kicking off a thread for the Pelican POC — customer wants to test a 13B conversational model on their private VPC. timeline = 2 week POC.
Miguel: thanks — are they restricted to open weights or can we propose a redwood-verified variant?
Ava: they prefer open models but are open to a tuned variant if we can guarantee isolation + kms.
Priya: quick compatibility check: do they need kv-cache sharing between warm instances? that affects memory and batch packing.
Ava: yes, they expect session continuity across scaled pods — sticky kv-cache preferred.
Priya: noted. we should recommend a quantized variant (8-bit) to meet their latency/cost targets. need to confirm sequence length distribution.
Ava: I asked for sample traffic — sent 2000 sample prompts earlier today (customer uploaded to S3).
Miguel: for the model, propose `pelican-13b-open-q8` as the candidate. fallback `pelican-13b-fp16` for quality-sensitive routes.
Tom: pricing heads-up: q8 should cut token cost ~35-40% vs fp16. but reserved capacity for POC will need a small commit (1 GPU weekend block).
Ava: customer asked about SLA during the POC. can we offer 99.9% for demo traffic?
Priya: for a two-week POC we can offer best-effort and 99.5% during scheduled demo windows. we need autoscale disabled for consistent measurements.
Zoe: security checklist: they require KMS integration with customer-managed keys, SOC2 attestation copy, and an IP allowlist for the private control plane. also a quick note on data residency.
Miguel: KMS + VPC private control plane ok, but need legal approval for customer-managed keys workflow.
Ava: logged in customer asks: any red flags with our model catalog? they want to run PII-redaction finetune on top in their environment.
Zoe: finetuning in customer VPC is fine if it's isolated — request an architecture diagram and data flow. no logs should leave their VPC.
Priya: operational note — if they finetune, we need to pin model version and disable automatic kernel swaps during the POC. also ensure kv cache is persisted only to ephemeral volumes.
Miguel: deployment plan draft: 1) provision dedicated GPU pool in their VPC (1xA10g), 2) push model artifact + quant profile, 3) run warmup script and run 5 perf runs.
Miguel: warmup script example:
```
python tools/warmup.py --model pelican-13b-open-q8 --seq 1024 --iters 10
```
Priya: add probe for response-quality: run 100 eval prompts, compute BLEU/ROUGE + human pass rate. need customer-defined acceptance criteria.
Ava: customer acceptance: latency < 250ms p50 for 512 tokens and < 20% quality regress vs their baseline.
Tom: cost ask: estimate for 2-week POC with 1A10g (24/7) + storage + data egress (minimal) — I'll send numbers end of day.
Zoe: one more blocker: they require SSO (SAML) for Console access and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. can we enable in the private control plane?
Miguel: SAML + syslog export supported in private deployments; will coordinate with infra to enable.
DeployBot: deploy request queued: pelican-13b-open-q8 -> staging-vpc-467, ETA 3h. (reaction :rocket:)
Ava: action items: Miguel to confirm infra hours and GPU commit, Priya to prepare warmup + eval harness, Tom to share POC pricing, Zoe to send security checklist template. I'll sync with customer tomorrow 10am PT.
Priya: will also run a quick local KV stress test and share memory profile.
Tom: pricing estimate posted to thread: https://redwood-internal/poc-estimates/7012349876 (internal).
Zoe: I'll need the architecture diagram by EOD to pre-clear KMS flow.
Ava: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source. ping me if you need to spin up testing earlier. :thumbsup:
